name: Tsuki Kurui no Yoru
source:
Peaceful kingdom collapses under assault of demon army. King throws up a white flag and comes under control of Demon King after kingdom's squadron aiming at demon's leader life gets defeated.
But young captain Philer can't accept the idea. With his teacher he moves towards the Demon King castle.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
和平的王国在魔军袭击下崩溃。王国军团试图取下魔王首级，却以失败告终，国王只得举起白旗，接受魔王的统治。
但年轻的队长菲勒无法接受这一切。他与老师一同前往魔王城堡。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
